gui.convert_table.growth.need_pedestal: Connect a pedestal to this crystal vein
gui.convert_table.growth.shared: The vein shares its growth factors
gui.convert_table.growth.no_buds: No active buds in the vein
gui.convert_table.viewer.preview: Materials and costs charged on completion
gui.convert_table.mode_hint.1: Sample in slot; process linked inputs
gui.convert_table.status.10: Put a sample in the input slot
gui.convert_table.mode_help.0: Consumes the input slot; sends products to output. Advanced reagents go in the reagent slot.
gui.convert_table.mode_help.1: Bind input and output containers with the connection rod. Exact mode uses the input-slot sample without consuming it; group mode accepts materials that convert to the target. Outputs go to the bound output containers.
gui.convert_table.mode_help.2: Place a shulker box in the input slot; its contents change in place. Exact mode locks the first converted material. Change mode or target to reset.
gui.convert_table.match_help: Linked: input slot is sample. Shulker exact filter: %s. Group mode accepts compatible recipes.
gui.convert_table.growth.run_help: Copy the matching original. Catalyst and original are retained. Changing either or the target pauses and clears progress.
gui.convert_table.growth.catalyst_help: Insert one reusable catalyst and one target item as the original.
gui.convert_table.growth.allocation_help: Working pedestals share extracted factors. Paused pedestals, missing samples and full output slots take no share.
gui.convert_table.growth.link_ready: + Container can receive the selected output
gui.convert_table.growth.link_blocked: ! Container present, but cannot receive this output
gui.convert_table.growth.credit_help: Delivered factors are saved and create an item at its cost threshold. Changing the recipe clears this credit.
gui.convert_table.growth.cluster_help: Extraction limit: 0 factors/s. Returns to a small bud when a pedestal works.
item.convert_table.connection_rod.input_: ▶ Input: left-click station and container, either order
item.convert_table.connection_rod.output: ◀ Output: right-click station and container, either order
item.convert_table.connection_rod.clear_: Repeat to remove; sneak-click station to clear that role
item.convert_table.connection_rod.first_: ▶ Input endpoint selected; left-click the other end

item.convert_table.connection_rod.output: Catalyst pedestals accept output links only
item.convert_table.connection_rod.invali: Choose a conversion table, catalyst pedestal or accessible container
item.convert_table.connection_rod.pair: Choose one station and one container; this endpoint is now selected
item.convert_table.connection_rod.unload: Other endpoint is unloaded; move closer and retry
item.convert_table.connection_rod.limit: At most 8 container links per station, counting both roles
item.convert_table.connection_rod.confli: One container cannot be both input and output
item.convert_table.connection_rod.range: Use an accessible container within 16 blocks of combined axis distance
jei.convert_table.growth.title: Catalyst Growth
jei.convert_table.growth.shared_network: Working pedestals share the vein's factors evenly
gui.convert_table.convert_help: Starts one batch. Materials and costs are charged when output completes. A waiting request starts automatically when ready.
gui.convert_table.run_help: Automatically repeats batches from the input slot, linked inputs or a shulker box. No further start clicks are needed. Waits for materials, costs or output room.
gui.convert_table.souls_help: Mob deaths on connected sculk surfaces provide 32 available souls per point of XP reward. Zero-XP mobs provide none. Ordinary batches cost 3 souls by default and wait when souls run out.
gui.convert_table.growth.growth_progress: Produce one item when its factor cost is reached. Pausing keeps progress; changing materials or the target clears it.
gui.convert_table.growth.production_help: Items/s = this pedestal's shared factors/s ÷ factors per item.
gui.convert_table.growth.transfer_progre: Supplies working pedestals with growth factors toward their next item.

gui.convert_table.growth.source_help: Original: one unmodified target item. It is a reusable sample and is never consumed.
jei.convert_table.growth.source_not_cons: Original is a reusable sample, never consumed
gui.convert_table.growth.mother_help: Budding amethyst grows buds. Immature buds provide growth factors.
gui.convert_table.growth.conductor_help: Amethyst blocks connect the vein. Calcite or smooth basalt beside a conductor affects the whole vein.
gui.convert_table.growth.pedestal_help: Insert a catalyst and original sample, then start growth. Shared factors produce items.
gui.convert_table.growth.intrinsic_sourc: Uses small, medium, large bud and mature-cluster counts in that order.
gui.convert_table.growth.supply_source: Each immature bud provides a base supply. Every calcite adds to its extraction limit.
gui.convert_table.growth.supply_loaded: Only loaded, connected immature buds count.
gui.convert_table.growth.calcite_effect: Each calcite adds 1/%s factor/s; contents stay the same and natural growth slows.
gui.convert_table.growth.basalt_effect: Each smooth basalt adds 1/%s to contents; extraction limits stay the same and growth slowdown is reduced.
gui.convert_table.growth.allocation_sour: Supply is shared as evenly as possible among working pedestals.
gui.convert_table.growth.allocation_reci: Paused pedestals, missing samples and full output slots take no share.
gui.convert_table.growth.stage_boosts: Calcite stacks extraction limits; smooth basalt stacks contents.
gui.convert_table.growth.boost_placement: Beside budding amethyst: local. Beside amethyst: the whole vein. Bonuses stack; each block counts once.
gui.convert_table.growth.boost_coverage: Affects %s mothers; %s total effects on immature buds.
